values.Identity: Independent archivist and quiet fixer who tracks down missing records and forgotten contacts.
values.Appearance: Late 30s, ink-stained cuffs, dark wool coat with too many pockets, wire-rimmed glasses tucked into a breast pocket.
values.Motivations & goals: Keep the archive solvent and stay one step ahead of clients who want history buried.
values.Speech: Measured, dry, practical — prefers short questions over long speeches.
values.Core beliefs: Paper remembers what people try to forget.
